title: Ghost of Many Faces
description: A large glowing ghost with multiple human faces embedded in its body dominates the surreal night scene. The ghost has three bright blue diamond-shaped eyes and a wide grin of sharp teeth, standing in a lavender field as a silhouetted man with a cane looks up at it under a starry sky with winding paths and floating red planets.
prompt: A surreal night scene featuring a massive glowing ghost with multiple embedded human faces on its body, three bright blue diamond eyes, and a wide sharp-toothed grin. The ghost floats above a field of purple lavender flowers. In the foreground, a black silhouette of a man with a cane stands looking up at the ghost. A winding path leads to a small house on a hill with tiny human figures walking along it. The dark green starry sky contains floating red planets and geometric constellation lines. Ethereal and eerie atmosphere with intricate linework.
